I'll verify this computation by executing code to calculate the day of the week 986 days after Friday, January 27, 2006.
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Start date
start_date = datetime(2006, 1, 27)
print(f"Start date: {start_date.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y')}")

# Add 986 days
end_date = start_date + timedelta(days=986)
print(f"End date (986 days later): {end_date.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y')}")

# Get the day of the week
day_of_week = end_date.strftime('%A')
print(f"Day of the week: {day_of_week}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

Based on the computed result, 986 days after Friday, January 27, 2006 is **Thursday, October 09, 2008**.

ANSWER: Thursday
